div.div: أَوْبَةً وَطَوْبَةً , [the latter word] meaning الطِّيبَ, [and both together A return and perfume,] is a phrase which one says to the person entering and to him coming [as though he who said this meant I experience a return that is to me like perfume]. (O.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
